policy: V1 production qualification accepts only real-domain pages whose benchmark/commercial qualification rights are bound to a reviewed, content-addressed rights record. Public availability alone is not authorization. Synthetic/self-authored pages may supplement edge cases but cannot satisfy real-domain minimums.

operator-owned-or-explicitly-permissione.note: Use only when the operator owns the pages or has explicit permission covering benchmark/quality qualification. The rights review record must enumerate every covered pageId.

manga109-s-v2026.note: Use only after the operator has been granted access and has reviewed the current Manga109-s terms. Corpus bytes remain external and must not be redistributed by this project.

open-mantra-cc-by-nc-4.0.note: The public repository license is CC BY-NC 4.0. Do not use it for this production/commercial V1 qualification unless a separate permission review creates a different operator-rights record.

synthetic-self-authored.note: Useful for renderer/security/edge-case checks only. It cannot satisfy real manga/manhwa/webtoon page minimums in the production corpus gate.
